arguments.summary: Selected five qualifying industrial sale comps in Columbus within 0.8–1.72 miles and within 52,000–116,000 sf, all closed between 2026-02-05 and 2026-06-09. Normalized considerations to USD and computed price per sf: four at $125/sf and one at ~$135.17/sf. Eligible records R1596 and R9925 met criteria but were not selected due to the distance-ranked cap of five. A duplicate second source (R8212) of R6807 was noted and excluded from the shortlist. An executed amendment for R1278 was applied; an executed amendment for R3282 published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff and an unsigned draft for R2008 were not applied. A comp-grid XLSX with citations has been generated.
limitations: Executed amendment U-R3282-2 (published/effective after cutoff) could change R3282’s consideration in later vintages; values here reflect pre-cutoff evidence.
The 2026-07-22 sale R2044 appears in-window by event date but was excluded because its base extract was published after the cutoff.
Limited deal-level attributes (e.g., tenancy mix, age, clear height) were not provided; comparability is based solely on filters specified.
Price-per-sf figures are simple divisions of total consideration by stated sf and may not reflect adjustments for land allocation or non-realty items, which were not provided.
